10. CHECK TIMING MARKS
(a) Rotate the crankshaft two times clockwise.
(b) Check the timing marks. (Refer to the section of IN-SPECTION AND ADJUSTMENT OF VALVE TIMING — See page EM-7)

15. INSTALL FLUID COUPLING WITH FAN SHROUD

18. INSTALL AIR CLEANER CASE WITH AIR INTAKE CONNECTOR

20. CONNECT CABLE TO NEGATIVE TERMINAL OF BATTERY
